build_NASFCOS_FPN: build a NASFCOS_FPN feature pyramid network with specified in_channels, out_channels, and num_outs parameters
run_NASFCOS_FPN_forward: run the forward pass of NASFCOS_FPN with backbone feature maps as input tensors
test_NASFCOS_FPN_init: test the NASFCOS_FPN initialization with in_channels list, out_channels int, and num_outs int
review_NASFCOS_FPN_forward: review the NASFCOS_FPN forward method that processes multi-scale features through concat cells and bilinear interpolation
refactor_NASFCOS_FPN_init_weights: refactor the NASFCOS_FPN init_weights method to apply caffe2_xavier_init to all Conv2d layers
